messages:
Rina: Heads-up: microburst just hit 16th & Mission — hail, blown umbrellas, lots of puddles. Muni buses detouring and a couple of shuttles queued up.
Devon: Just witnessed two scooters do the full cartoon slide. Hope everyone's okay. Anyone near 16th with a towel?
Lina: At 16th & Valencia, I can spare a towel and a plastic bag for wet shoes. Office shuttle looks like it's rerouting via 18th, +10-15m.
transit-bot: MUNI alert: Routes 14 and 48 detoured between Mission and Valencia due to weather. Expect delays; updated ETAs posted.
Ethan: Also seeing Caltrain slowdowns toward SF due to signal trouble at Millbrae — could cascade into morning commutes.
Rina: If you're coming from South Bay, maybe take 280 express or carpool. I can swing by for a pick-up if anyone's stranded.
Devon: My keyboard took a splash of cold water and coffee. RIP? Anyone have a spare keycap or a tiny towel? :sob:
Lina: Leave it at the front desk labeled "Devon rescue" and I'll patch you up when I get in.
Jorge: Leaving Dogpatch now, can detour to pick up Devon if needed. ETA ~10m.
Rina: Huge, thanks Jorge. @Devon DM me your cross-street and I'll tell the shuttle driver to hold if there's space.
Mira: For bikers: avoid the 19th bike lane near the mural, it's a sheet of water. Use the market-side bike path instead.
transit-bot: Office shuttle update: Shuttle #3 rerouted via 18th St. Minor delay; capacity 6/12. Standby riders welcome.
Devon: Saved — Jorge heroically stopped, Lina's towel was a life-saver, and shuttle waited. Keyboard may live. Coffee replacement fund incoming. :coffee::money_with_wings:
Rina: Quick heads-up for slackers: allow +15m before your 9am standups today unless you hear otherwise.
Ethan: From Millbrae, I'll be ~25m late. Apologies.
Mira: Phone got soaked, battery is limping. Anyone have a spare USB-C charger I can borrow? I'll Venmo for coffee.
Jorge: I have a spare charger in my bag. I'll drop it at reception and label it "Mira".
Rina: Thanks everyone — real-life logistics >> calendar invites. Microburst chaos averted. :tornado:
transit-bot: Facility notice: Bike room lockers available for temporary gear storage today.
